scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=client && node scripts/bundle-static-assets.mjs && npm run build --workspace=server && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.copyFileSync('server/dist/index.js','dist/index.js'); fs.copyFileSync('server/dist/index.js','dist/server.js')"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=server && npm run test --workspace=client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=server && npm run lint --workspace=client
